import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "A", "a", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "B", "b", "2026-01-01"),   # deleted
    (3, "other", "o", "C", "c", None),       # cross-tenant
    (4, "t", "someone", "D", "d", None),     # cross-owner
    (5, "t", "o'x", "E", "e", None),         # quote in owner
    (6, "t'", "o", "F", "f", None),          # quote in tenant
    (7, "t", "o", "G", "g'", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

# get_document: accessible record
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"}
# unavailable: deleted, cross-tenant, cross-owner, missing -> all None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None
assert get_document(c, "other", "o", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "someone", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None
# quoted names are matched literally
assert get_document(c, "t", "o'x", 5) == {"id": 5, "title": "E", "body": "e"}
assert get_document(c, "t'", "o", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "F", "body": "f"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 5) is None
assert get_document(c, "t\" OR 1=1 --", "o", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1", 1) is None

# list_documents: only accessible records, ordered by id, no deleted_at
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "A", "body": "a"},
    {"id": 7, "title": "G", "body": "g'"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o'x") == [{"id": 5, "title": "E", "body": "e"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1") == []
assert list_documents(c, "other", "o") == [{"id": 3, "title": "C", "body": "c"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "nobody") == []
for doc in list_documents(c, "t", "o"):
    assert set(doc) == {"id", "title", "body"}
print("checks/test_access.py ok")
